siteOptions.blogdescription: Playground demo for Insert Headers and Footers
siteOptions.ihaf_insert_header:
<!--
  Demo: Global Header via WPCode

  This entire block is injected into the <head> of every page via
  Code Snippets → Header & Footer → "Header".

  What to check:
  - View Source and search for "wpcode-header" to see the meta tag.
  - Check <head> for the <style> block and <script>.
  - Open DevTools → Console to see the log from this script.
-->

<!-- Marker so you can spot this quickly in View Source -->
<meta name="demo" content="wpcode-header" />

<!--
  Simple visual cue: when the header script runs, it adds the "wpcode-demo"
  class to <body>, which triggers this top border.
-->
<style>
  body.wpcode-demo {
    border-top: 4px solid #2271b1;
    margin-top: 0;
  }
</style>

<!--
  This script runs on every front-end page load because it's in the global header.
  It:
  - Adds the "wpcode-demo" class to <body> (see CSS above).
  - Logs to the console so you can confirm execution.
  Replace this with your analytics tag, pixel loader, etc.
-->
<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    document.body.classList.add('wpcode-demo');
    console.log('WPCode demo: header script ran (global header)');
  });
</script>
siteOptions.ihaf_insert_footer:
<!--
  Demo: Global Footer script

  This script is injected just before </body> on every page via the
  "Footer" field. Use this area for scripts that should run after the
  page has loaded (e.g. chat widgets, A/B testing, extra tracking).

  What to check:
  - Open DevTools → Console and reload a front-end page to see the log.
  - Confirm in View Source that this script appears near </body>.
-->
<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    console.log('WPCode demo: footer script ran (global footer)');

    // If the body snippet created the #wpcode-demo-banner element,
    // tweak its text so you can see header+body+footer all working together.
    var banner = document.getElementById('ihaf-demo-banner');
    if (banner) {
      banner.textContent += ' — modified by footer script';
    }
  });
</script>
